target.period: 01 May through 31 December 2020 at nine specified cumulative snapshots; exposure period 1999–2016

coverage.notes: Official outcome extraction covers 96 departments x 9 snapshots. No analytic rows were included because independent department PM2.5 exposure values and a complete published-covariate panel were not retrieved.

blockers: The independently identified ACAG PM2.5 catalogue was reachable but its nested Europe raster payload was not delivered through the public Box endpoint in this run; no 1999–2016 department exposure can be assigned without inventing values.
A complete independent 96-department panel for all ten published adjustment covariates was not retrieved.
Consequently the principal adjusted negative-binomial comparison was not executed.
